caseName: Wright v. Union Central Life Insurance
caseNameFull: Wright v. Union Central Life Insurance Co.
attorneys: Messrs. Samuel E. Cook, Wm. Lemke, Elmer McClain, and Ray M. Foreman for petitioner., Messrs. Louis M: Maiitynband, Stanley K. Henshaw, and Virgie D. Parish for respondent.

opinions.text: In view of the Act of August 24, 1937 (50 Stat. 751), the Court hereby certifies to the Attorney General of the United States that the constitutionality of § 75 of the Bankruptcy Act, as amended by the Act of August 28, 1935 (49 Stat. 942), is drawn in question in this cause.
